howToPlay: Use your lightning strikes to zone out enemies and control the area. Once your Super is charged, trap foes within the electric storm to secure massive damage. Combine your gadgets and star powers to punish opponents who get too close.
gears: Use SPEED and DAMAGE to maximize your mobility and offensive pressure. SHIELD or HEALTH are excellent alternatives for staying on the field longer as a controller.
trait: This brawler suits those who enjoy tactical map control and punishing enemies with precise area-of-effect damage.
